steps.do: Read the money accounts, spend register, budget and ownership record, and list what is missing, most needed first.
Ask the founder which bank, card and payment accounts the venture uses and their balances today.
Ask which subscriptions and recurring costs the venture pays, and draft one spend register entry for each.
Ask who owns the venture and in what shares, and record it; any change to it goes to the founder.

Draft a base budget for the next 12 months from the spend register, the accounts and what the founder expects to earn, one line per category and month, each citing its record or marked as an assumption, and ask the founder to confirm the categories.
Write the money summary: cash, monthly burn and months of runway projected from the budget, each figure citing the records it came from.

done_criteria.check: Does every figure in the money summary cite the account or spend entries it came from?
